outcome: duration of active first stage of labor
duration of second stage of labor
cohort: The study included all women with 2 or more vaginal deliveries of a singleton child in cephalic position, between 22 and 42 weeks of gestation, at the University Hospital of Zurich from 2004 to 2021.
finding: Up to the third delivery, the duration of labor significantly decreased with each consecutive delivery of the same parturient.
mod_finding: Neuraxial anesthesia was an independent risk factor for a longer duration of labor during vaginal deliveries, irrespective of parity.
birth_weight: N/A (birthweight of the first child was analyzed as a variable, not an inclusion criterion)
